aka.zh: 依若高速（依吞布拉克至若羌段）

tagline.en: The third expressway into Xinjiang: round the north of Qinghai Lake, over the Altun mountains and along the southern edge of the Taklamakan to Hotan — with its Qinghai gaps still being filled
tagline.zh: 进出新疆的第三条高速大通道：绕青海湖北岸，翻阿尔金山，沿塔克拉玛干沙漠南缘抵和田——青海境内的缺口仍在填补

start.en: Lao Mangya, Mangya City, Qinghai, at the eastern end of the Huangualiang–Mangya expressway, where the drawn line begins. The route is planned to continue east across the Qaidam to Xining; see below
start.zh: 青海省茫崖市老茫崖，黄瓜梁至茫崖高速公路东端，所绘线段由此开始。路线规划继续向东穿越柴达木盆地直至西宁，详见下文

end.en: Luopu East interchange in Lop County, east of Hotan, where it meets G3012 Turpan–Hotan Expressway
end.zh: 和田以东洛浦县的洛浦东互通，与 G3012 吐和高速相接

en: G0612 is a spur of G6, the Beijing–Lhasa Expressway, planned from Xining in Qinghai to Hotan in southern Xinjiang. According to the junction list in Chinese Wikipedia, it begins by Xining's Caojiapu airport and shares the Xining ring road and then G6 as far as Huangyuan. From there it is to run north-west past Haiyan and along the north shore of Qinghai Lake through Gangca and Tianjun, join the Chaka–Delingha expressway into Delingha, and cross the Qaidam basin by Xiaochaidan to Mangya on the Xinjiang border. In Xinjiang it climbs over the Altun mountains to Ruoqiang, then runs west along the southern edge of the Taklamakan by Qiemo, Minfeng, Yutian and Qira to Lop County, east of Hotan, where it meets G3012.

The Xinjiang end is built; the Qinghai end is not yet continuous. When the Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang section opened in August 2022, the Xinjiang government's development commission called it the third expressway corridor into or out of Xinjiang, after G30 and G7. The atlas draws the route in two pieces. This page is anchored on the longer one, from Lao Mangya in Qinghai to Lop County; the other is the Xining–Chahannuo stretch in Qinghai.
zh: G0612 是 G6 京藏高速的联络线，规划自青海西宁至新疆南部的和田。据中文维基百科的互通列表，它起于西宁曹家堡机场附近，先后与西宁绕城高速、G6 京藏高速共线至湟源。此后规划向西北经海晏，沿青海湖北岸过刚察、天峻，接茶德高速进入德令哈，再经小柴旦横穿柴达木盆地，至青新交界的茫崖。进入新疆后翻越阿尔金山到若羌，再沿塔克拉玛干沙漠南缘向西，经且末、民丰、于田、策勒，至和田以东的洛浦县，与 G3012 相接。
新疆一端已经建成，青海一端尚未连通。2022 年 8 月依吞布拉克至若羌段通车时，新疆维吾尔自治区发展和改革委员会称其为继 G30 连霍高速、G7 京新高速之后进出疆的第三条高速公路大通道。地图把这条路画成两段；本页定位在较长的一段，即青海老茫崖至新疆洛浦县，另一段是青海境内的西宁至察汗诺。

en: The hardest piece is Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang, 294 km wholly within Ruoqiang County, designed for 120 km/h. Its mountain stretches average nearly 3,300 m above sea level, and it crosses two empty regions, the Lop Nur and the Altun mountains. The 2017 tender for it listed three extra-long tunnels totalling 14,220 m; the longest single bore reported is the 4.73 km Bashkurgan No. 2 tunnel. Where it passes through a nature reserve, the builders put the road on 176 bridges, 22.78 km in all, to leave crossings for wildlife.

West of Ruoqiang the ground is flat desert edge. Ruoqiang–Minfeng is 530.2 km of four-lane road on a 27 m roadbed, designed for 120 km/h, with eight pairs of service areas. Minfeng–Luopu, 266.883 km, was built not as an expressway but as a class-I highway for 100 km/h; it was built under the name of National Road 315 and links to the Moyu–Hotan road at Luopu East.

In Qinghai, Huangualiang–Mangya, 150.1 km, was built largely on an existing oilfield road: 33.4 km of it is the old Mangya–oilfield road as it was, and for another 116.7 km that road became one carriageway, with a new one built beside it. China Central Television called it Qinghai's first road through an oil-production area. Xihai–Chahannuo, on the north shore of Qinghai Lake at an average altitude of about 3,600 m, was built to class-I standard for 100 km/h.
zh: 最难修的是依吞布拉克至若羌段：全长 294 公里，全部位于若羌县境内，设计时速 120 公里。山岭重丘区路段平均海拔近 3,300 米，穿越罗布泊、阿尔金山两大“无人区”。2017 年的招标公告列有特长隧道 3 座、共 14,220 米；报道中最长的是全长 4.73 公里的巴什库尔干 2 号隧道。穿越自然保护区的范围内，建设方共架设桥梁 176 座、计 22.78 公里，为野生动物留出迁徙通道。
若羌以西是平坦的沙漠边缘。若羌至民丰段全长 530.2 公里，双向四车道，路基宽 27 米，设计时速 120 公里，设服务区 8 对。民丰至洛浦段 266.883 公里则没有按高速公路修建，而是按设计时速 100 公里的一级公路标准建设，以国道 315 线的名义建成，在洛浦东与墨玉至和田公路相接。
青海境内的黄瓜梁至茫崖段 150.1 公里，利用了原有的油田公路：其中 33.4 公里完全利用茫油石公路，另 116.7 公里以茫油石公路作右幅、新建左幅，组成双向四车道。央视称其为青海首条穿越采油区的公路。青海湖北岸的西海至察汗诺段平均海拔约 3,600 米，按设计时速 100 公里的一级公路标准建设。

en: Before the expressway, the corridor was National Road 315. In October 2005 the Xinjiang government reported that the 571 km ordinary road from Ruoqiang to Minfeng was nearly finished, completing the first upgrade of the road round the Tarim basin.

In Qinghai, Delingha–Xiaochaidan in the Qaidam was finished in 2011 and is co-signed with provincial expressway S20. Most of the rest came in a rush after 2017. Ruoqiang–Minfeng was begun in 2017 and opened on 30 December 2021, ending, the Ruoqiang county government said, the county's years without an expressway. Minfeng–Luopu was begun in October 2020 and opened on 30 June 2022. It was the last link in a ring of high-grade roads round the Tarim basin, and it took Xinjiang's expressways and class-I roads past 10,000 km. Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang opened on 30 August 2022.

In Qinghai, Xihai–Chahannuo was handed over in December 2022, opened in part on 10 June 2023 and throughout on 26 December 2023. Huangualiang–Mangya opened on 26 October 2023, and on 12 January 2024 it was joined to Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang at the provincial border. Two gaps remain. Work on the 50.7 km Huangyuan–Xihai section began on 4 April 2023. Sources disagree on when it will open: in June 2026 the Qinghai transport department said it would open that year, while a Guangming Online report in August 2026 gave the end of 2027. Only the connector from the Xihai junction to the Atomic City (Yuanzicheng) interchange has opened so far, on 1 December 2024. Further west, Qinghai's transport department tendered the design in 2023 for a 391.658 km rebuild of National Road 315 from Xiaochaidan Lake to the Lao Mangya junction, to 100 and 120 km/h standards, and in November 2025 the provincial transport holding company reported it under construction.
zh: 高速公路修建之前，这条通道是国道 315 线。2005 年 10 月，新疆维吾尔自治区政府通报，全长 571 公里的 315 国道若羌至民丰普通公路即将完工，环塔里木盆地公路改造由此初步完成。

青海境内，柴达木盆地中的德令哈至小柴旦段 2011 年建成，与青海省级高速 S20 共线。其余大部分路段在 2017 年后集中建设。若羌至民丰段 2017 年开工，2021 年 12 月 30 日通车，若羌县政府称这补齐了若羌县无高速公路的短板。民丰至洛浦段 2020 年 10 月开工，2022 年 6 月 30 日通车。它是塔里木盆地高等级公路环线的最后一环，通车后新疆高速（含一级）公路里程突破 1 万公里。依吞布拉克至若羌段于 2022 年 8 月 30 日通车。

青海境内，西海至察汗诺段 2022 年 12 月交工，2023 年 6 月 10 日部分路段开通运营，12 月 26 日全线通车。黄瓜梁至茫崖段 2023 年 10 月 26 日建成通车，2024 年 1 月 12 日与新疆依吞布拉克至若羌段在省界联网运营。仍有两处缺口。50.7 公里的湟源至西海段 2023 年 4 月 4 日开工；何时通车说法不一：2026 年 6 月青海省交通运输厅称年内即可全线通车，2026 年 8 月光明网报道则称目标为 2027 年底全线通车。迄今通车的只有西海枢纽至原子城互通连接线，于 2024 年 12 月 1 日开通。再往西，青海省交通运输厅 2023 年对 315 国道小柴旦湖至老茫崖段约 391.658 公里的改扩建工程进行勘察设计招标，设计时速 100 和 120 公里；2025 年 11 月，青海省交通控股集团称该项目正在施工。

en: No total has been published; G0612 is being built by Qinghai and Xinjiang as separate projects, each costed on its own. The section figures that are public show how much the mountains add. In Xinjiang, Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang, 294 km, cost ¥14.409 billion, or about ¥49 million a kilometre. Ruoqiang–Minfeng, 530.2 km across flat desert, was estimated at ¥13.828 billion, and the class-I Minfeng–Luopu road, 266.883 km, at ¥7.5 billion. In 2005 the 571 km ordinary road between Ruoqiang and Minfeng had been reported at ¥917 million.

In Qinghai, Huangualiang–Mangya, which reused an oilfield road, cost ¥2.463 billion for 150.1 km. Xihai–Chahannuo was about ¥10.342 billion, and the 50.7 km Huangyuan–Xihai section is budgeted at ¥5.66 billion.

Two sections were built as public–private partnerships. In 2017 the Xinjiang government approved a PPP package covering G0612 Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang along with G0711 and a desert road; the project company for Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang is CCCC Xinjiang Transportation Investment and Development Co. Xihai–Chahannuo was Qinghai's first transport PPP, invested in by China MCC23, China Railway No. 5 Engineering Group and the Qinghai transport holding company, among others. The Minfeng–Luopu road is toll-free.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价；G0612 由青海、新疆分项目建设、分别核算。从已公开的分段数字可以看出山区对造价的影响。新疆境内，依吞布拉克至若羌段 294 公里总投资 144.09 亿元，每公里约 4,900 万元；横穿平坦沙漠边缘的若羌至民丰段 530.2 公里，概算总投资 138.28 亿元；按一级公路修建的民丰至洛浦段 266.883 公里，概算投资 75 亿元。相比之下，2005 年若羌至民丰之间 571 公里的普通公路，报道的总投资为 9.17 亿元。
青海境内，利用油田公路改建的黄瓜梁至茫崖段 150.1 公里总投资 24.63 亿元；西海至察汗诺段投资约 103.42 亿元；50.7 公里的湟源至西海段预算投资 56.6 亿元。
其中两段采用政府和社会资本合作（PPP）模式。2017 年，新疆维吾尔自治区政府批准乌鲁木齐至尉犁等公路项目采用 PPP 模式，包括 G0612 依吞布拉克至若羌段以及 G0711 和一条沙漠公路；依若高速的建设单位为中交新疆交通投资发展有限公司。西海至察汗诺段是青海省交通领域首个 PPP 项目，由五矿二十三冶、中铁五局、青海省交通控股集团等单位联合投资建设。民丰至洛浦段不收费。

en: The expressway has cut journey times along the southern Tarim. Xinjiang's transport department put Ruoqiang–Minfeng at four and a half hours, down from ten. Hotan prefecture put Minfeng–Hotan at three hours, down from six. A lorry driver quoted by the Ruoqiang county government said the old mountain road from Ruoqiang to Yitunbulak took seven or eight hours, and the expressway a little over three. In Qinghai, Xihai–Chahannuo cut the drive from Haibei to Haixi along the north of the lake from three and a half hours to two.

Ruoqiang–Minfeng was approved for trial tolling in December 2021. Minfeng–Luopu, a class-I road, is toll-free. Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang is tolled at four stations: Yitunbulak, Lop Nur, Miran and Ruoqiang East.
zh: 高速公路大大缩短了塔里木盆地南缘的车程。新疆维吾尔自治区交通运输厅称，若羌至民丰的驾车时间从 10 个小时缩短至 4 个半小时；和田地区称，民丰至和田的车程从 6 个小时缩短至 3 个小时。若羌县政府报道中的一位货车司机说，过去走 315 国道山区路段从若羌到依吞布拉克要七八个小时，走高速只需三个多小时。青海境内，西察公路通车后，从海北州向北绕青海湖抵达海西州的时间由 3.5 小时缩短至 2 小时。
若羌至民丰段 2021 年 12 月获批试行收取车辆通行费。按一级公路建设的民丰至洛浦段不收费。依吞布拉克至若羌段设依吞布拉克、罗布泊、米兰、若羌东 4 个收费站。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. G0612 is being built by Qinghai and Xinjiang as separate projects, each costed on its own, and parts in Qinghai are not yet built; the published section costs are listed separately below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。G0612 由青海、新疆分项目建设、分别核算，青海境内部分路段尚未建成；已公布的路段造价另列如下。

value.en: Published only for two sections, both public–private partnerships. Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang was part of a Xinjiang PPP package approved in 2017, with CCCC Xinjiang Transportation Investment and Development Co. as the project company. Xihai–Chahannuo was Qinghai's first transport PPP, invested in by China MCC23, China Railway No. 5 Engineering Group and the Qinghai transport holding company, among others. Who paid for the other sections has not been found.
value.zh: 仅两段公布了出资方式，均为 PPP。依吞布拉克至若羌段属新疆 2017 年批准的 PPP 项目包，建设单位为中交新疆交通投资发展有限公司；西海至察汗诺段为青海省交通领域首个 PPP 项目，由五矿二十三冶、中铁五局、青海省交通控股集团等单位联合投资建设。其余路段的出资方未查到。

timeline.en: Delingha–Xiaochaidan in the Qaidam is finished.
timeline.zh: 柴达木盆地中的德令哈至小柴旦段建成。

timeline.en: Xinjiang approves Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang as a public–private partnership and puts it out to tender; work on Ruoqiang–Minfeng begins.
timeline.zh: 新疆批准依吞布拉克至若羌段采用 PPP 模式并公开招标；若羌至民丰段开工。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Minfeng–Luopu class-I road in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，民丰至洛浦一级公路开工。
12 月 30 日，530.2 公里的若羌至民丰段通车。

timeline.en: Minfeng–Luopu opens on 30 June, closing the ring of high-grade roads round the Tarim basin; Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang opens on 30 August.
timeline.zh: 6 月 30 日，民丰至洛浦段通车，塔里木盆地高等级公路环线闭合；8 月 30 日，依吞布拉克至若羌段通车。

timeline.en: Huangyuan–Xihai is begun on 4 April; Huangualiang–Mangya opens on 26 October; Xihai–Chahannuo opens throughout on 26 December.
timeline.zh: 4 月 4 日，湟源至西海段开工；10 月 26 日，黄瓜梁至茫崖段通车；12 月 26 日，西海至察汗诺段全线通车。

timeline.en: Huangualiang–Mangya is joined to Yitunbulak–Ruoqiang at the Qinghai–Xinjiang border on 12 January; the Xihai–Atomic City connector opens on 1 December.
timeline.zh: 1 月 12 日，黄瓜梁至茫崖段与依吞布拉克至若羌段在青新省界联网运营；12 月 1 日，西海枢纽至原子城互通连接线开通。

timeline.en: Qinghai reports the rebuild of National Road 315 from Xiaochaidan Lake to Lao Mangya under construction.
timeline.zh: 青海称 315 国道小柴旦湖至老茫崖段正在施工。
